judgment.notes: H002 gives λ≥0, hence λ+1 is a positive integer with a canonical natural-number interpretation. This abbreviation assumes no additional positivity.
The bounded integer interval is finite for every integer λ, including the empty case; H002 later supplies 0∈I and its cardinality is exported by N001.

Natural divided powers are defined over ℂ, where r! is nonzero, including 0!=1. Enveloping elements and their induced representation operators are distinguished; the representation is supplied by H003, not a new hypothesis.
The same characteristic-zero factorial construction defines Y_r for every natural r. No reduction modulo p or invertibility in K is assumed here.

The unital ℤ-subalgebra generated by the specified enveloping elements is a legitimate generated subalgebra. Its induced action comes from H003; stability of M is explicitly H005, not granted by this definition.
For i∈I, i≥0, so the natural power and factorial in y^iv/i! are defined over ℂ. No independence, nonvanishing or spanning property is assumed; these are exported by N001.
With p prime in H001, denominators not divisible by p form a multiplicative set, so the displayed rationals form the usual subring of ℚ⊂ℂ. No valuation or principality assertion is imported.
The tensor product R⊗ℤM exists for the additive subgroup M and has its canonical R-module structure. Freeness and embedding into V remain conclusions of N002.

The scalar multiplication pairing is ℤ-balanced and induces the stated R-linear map, with image exactly the R-span of M. Identification with that image is explicitly deferred until N002 proves injectivity.

N001 supplies the complex basis required for unique linear extension of the displayed basis values. The guard is explicit and every inference listing D010 has N001 as a direct input. No matrix-unit preservation is assumed.

H002 permits λ to index the natural divided-power families. Composition Y_λX_λ is a complex-linear endomorphism; equality with a coordinate projection is left to N002. Pi only renames the supplied proof's operator P.

J_i is the inverse image of the R-submodule iota(M_R) under the R-linear map c↦ce_i from ℂ. Thus the declared submodule exists without assuming any basis or nonzero property. Equality among the J_i and finite generation remain N003 conclusions.
H002 gives 0∈I, so J_0 is available. This defines one coordinate submodule without assuming equality with other coordinates, nonzero rank, or principality.

M⊗ℤK is canonically a K-vector space for any additive subgroup M. The operator action is explicitly conditional on preservation of M, exported by N002 and used in N005; nonzero dimension and irreducibility are not definitions.

H003 supplies the Chevalley bracket with integer structure constants, making ℤx+ℤy+ℤh a Lie algebra over ℤ whose scalar extension exists over K. The construction uses the Lie algebra generators, not their possibly nonfaithful matrices on V; it therefore includes λ=0 and p=2. The action is guarded by lattice preservation.
H001 makes ℤ/pℤ a field and the integer map into K has kernel pℤ; its induced embedding identifies precisely the prime subfield. No algebraic closure assumption is added.

For p∤b, H001 implies b·1_K≠0. Equality of rational representatives gives equality of the displayed fractions by cross multiplication; addition, multiplication and unity are preserved. This constructs the ring map using existing conditions, with no extra denominator assumption.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
